name: Janna
notes: Zephyr is maxed first since it is Janna's most frequent and best-scaling damage cast, followed by Eye of the Storm for its attack-damage steroid uptime, with Howling Gale maxed last as it is cast least often.

Janna opens by casting Howling Gale, Zephyr and Eye of the Storm as soon as each is off cooldown (all essentially at t=0), then keeps auto-attacking between casts and recasting each ability the moment its cooldown ends.

Howling Gale is always charged to its full 3 seconds before being recast: charging does not lock out attacking or casting and only delays when the (much larger) single hit lands, and its 14s cooldown starts at the initial cast rather than at the recast.

Howling Gale's damage is read as scaling continuously with the exact seconds charged (matching its continuously increasing range/speed formula in the wiki template), not in discrete whole-second steps.

Howling Gale's recast damage lands 1.25s after the whirlwind is launched (its missile travel time); the initial cast and the manual recast are both treated as separate ability activations for on-cast effects such as Spellblade, but only the recast's landing hit triggers on-damage effects such as Muramana.

Zephyr is cast on the dummy on cooldown; its 0.245s cast time is the only delay modeled for it, the same treatment Jax's Leap Strike dash gets, since the short remaining projectile travel is not worth modeling separately.

Tailwind's bonus magic damage (30% of bonus movement speed) is added to every basic attack and to Zephyr's damage instance; the bonus movement speed used excludes Zephyr's own passive movement-speed buff, since the dossier states that passive is not a factor in a stationary-dummy fight, leaving only boots/item movement speed as the input.

Eye of the Storm is cast on herself on cooldown purely for the bonus attack damage it grants its target while the 4s shield holds; the shield's damage absorption (defensive) and the passive's cooldown refund on slowing/knocking up an enemy champion are not modeled, matching the dossier's own classification of that refund as not affecting the damage fight.
Monsoon (R) is never cast: it only heals and knocks back, dealing no damage to a stationary dummy.
Mana costs are ignored; at level 16 they do not meaningfully bind a rotation of casts this short.

assumed.why: Janna's fixed base movement speed (325) is needed to isolate the 'bonus' movement speed that Tailwind converts into magic damage; it is not stated in the provided sources but is a constant baseline champion stat.
